title: Not good so far
body: The app has nice features but I have to open and close the app 4 or 5 times before it will actually work. Sometimes I give up on even trying to open it. I’m a half of a day in and I might be canceling the trial.

title: Locked out
body: So I subscribed to pro it acted like I didn’t do anything. Everything stayed locked. lightning strike upgraded weather monitoring nothing work I’d like my refund. Thank you.

title: Stole my money
body: Impossible to cancel . I had to have bank stop payment

title: Subscription
body: Be aware of this app. I have cancelled my subscription and they have now charged me twice in the same month. Next step will be to contact the BBB.

title: Stop the bait and switch
body: Sick and tired of apps that say “in app purchase” only to have it completely paywalled. With zero functionality just say you’re charging for the app and stop wasting my time.

title: No free version… and
body: PIA to cancel after you get in.

title: Not as good as I was hoping
body: Looks like they had all of the reviews removed. I will have to add my review again. I have given the app a try and can’t justify paying money for it. They are constantly saying “new updates coming” so it’s not worth paying full price for what seems to be a Beta version of the app. Not as good as I was hoping.

title: I’m getting absolutely nothing for my money here
body: I have tried multiple times to tell the app what zone I am in and it just sits there without accepting it. When I go to the forecast page, all it says is that there will be forecasted weather in the winter. I have no idea what I am paying for.

title: Pay for radar?
body: Am I missing something? The only feature that works is radar. What are we paying for exactly?

title: Inaccurate Estimates
body: The weather estimates are always 3-5 degrees lower than the actuals. It’s so off and unreliable. I appreciate the articles and maps but the daily temps are very unhelpful

title: Exceptional app and customer service
body: Because I trust the analysis of the app creator, whom I have followed and still follow on Facebook, I decided to download the app. Personally, I had a couple of issues after I installed the app. It was my issue and I had to go to customer service twice but finally have a whole lot of patients on their side the problem was solved so A+ for patience, for customer service and the information

title: Great lightning notification app
body: The app developer is always open for feedback. He often responds very quickly to any comments and or concerns with the app/website.

title: Zoodylu
body: Sina is a fantastic forecaster. He updates frequently and rarely misses. I 1000% recommend this ap.

title: Excellent
body: Dina is spot on

title: Outstanding App
body: This is my “go-to” app for weather! Focused and accurate! Great graphics!

title: Location pin on Radar
body: Great products. Any chances that within a future update we will have the ability to set either a current location pin or location pins of interest? Lastly how about the ability when zooming in within a map product additional cities appear? Thanks in advance.

title: Accurate Weather Reporting
body: I have found this app offers the most accurate and detailed weather reports- I check it daily!

title: Great Product
body: I’ve been using this app for the past year to get an in-depth overview of local weather forecasts and it goes above and beyond what other apps can do! Very happy!

title: The Only Reliable Weather!
body: This is the only app that gets it right.

title: June
body: I enjoy the app. I am sure there is more to the app that I am not using. I don’t use the radar. I prefer weather channel’s radar.

title: Great App
body: This app is so dead on with the weather, particularly rainfall. They get every time slot perfectly.

title: The BEST period.
body: The best, and the most accurate ever! Get ZoneWatch and say goodbye to the rest!!!

title: Great weather app
body: Super cool weather app. Tons of features. Instant notifications. I really enjoy it.

title: Super accurate app
body: I spend lots of time outdoors and this app has been SO helpful with its pinpoint radar information especially with this summer’s pop up showers and thunderstorms. The alerts keep you notified and a feature I definitely need.

title: 100% Worth It
body: This weather app is consistently accurate. It also gives a bunch of other good info, like sunrise/sunset, moon phase, etc. Exactly what I’ve been looking for. Also seems like they update often with new features.

title: Getting better and better!
body: I take a lot of photos and live close to the ocean, so I’ve tried a bunch of weather apps. This one’s been way more accurate than the others, especially with the new sunlight thing. Helps a lot when I’m trying to catch the right light.

title: Best Weather App
body: This is such a great app! My favorite feature is that it shows when the best lighting for photos will be. I can combine my two favorite hobbies; hiking with my dog and taking photos of my dog.

title: Reliable and good for outdoors
body: Living in Shaver Lake, it’s tough to find a weather app that actually works this far out, but ZoneWatch has been one of the few that consistently delivers. I’ve relied on it for a while, but today’s solar update finally pushed me to leave a review. I usually stack firewood or get work done outside early, so being able to see first light along with dew point makes a real difference. The snow and wind alerts have already proven their worth more than once this winter. It’s not flashy, but it’s reliable, and that matters most out here.

title: Getting better every day!
body: This is a great app and because it’s new to all of us there will, of course, be a learning curve. I ran into the same thing as another poster when on the screen where you choose the regions that you want to follow. Once the developer explained to me how that screen works it made perfect sense. The developers are already implementing tweaks here and there to have the app flow more smoothly. There are some great things on the horizon and I honestly feel this will be the best weather app available.
